slice: WP factory setting sheets: 2025 KTM 450 SX-F US fork and shock (2026-11)

records.topic: Fork setting sheet A460C159Y406000: clickers, air pressure by rider weight, oil
records.statement: WP's setting sheet for the 2025 450 SX-F US fork (article A460C159Y406000, shared with the Factory Edition): compression 12 clicks out standard (17 comfort, 7 sport); rebound 18 clicks out standard (23 comfort, 13 sport). Air pressure by rider weight: 10.3 bar (149 psi) for 143-165 lb, 10.5 bar (152 psi) standard for 165-187 lb, 10.7 bar (155 psi) for 187-209 lb. Service fill: 380 ml in the right damper cartridge, 240 ml in each outer tube (190 to 250 ml allowed), 5 g of grease in the left air cartridge, SAE 4 oil. Fork travel 310 mm, fork length 950 mm.

records.topic: Shock setting sheet A460C459Y408000: clickers, sag, springs by rider weight, gas pressure
records.statement: WP's setting sheet for the 2025 450 SX-F US shock (article A460C459Y408000, shared with the Factory Edition): low-speed compression 15 clicks out standard (17 comfort, 13 sport); high-speed compression 1.5 turns out standard (2 comfort, 1 sport); rebound 15 clicks out standard (17 comfort, 13 sport). Static sag 35 mm, rider sag 105 mm, spring preload 8 mm. Springs by rider weight: 42 N/mm for 143-165 lb (KTM 91210132), 45 N/mm standard for 165-187 lb (KTM 91210133), 48 N/mm for 187-209 lb (KTM 91210134); all 240 mm long. Gas pressure 10 bar (145 psi), SAE 2.5 oil. Shock length 456.3 mm, stroke 140.1 mm.
